title: The Monster Blueprint
tagline: one name for a bundle of facts
hints: A struct is declared once, above your functions: `struct Monster { std::string name; int hp; int attack; };` - and yes, that semicolon after the closing brace is required.
Make one with braces in declaration order: `Monster goblin{"goblin", 12, 3};` - name, then hp, then attack.
`const Monster& m` for functions that only look. `Monster& m` for `wound`, which has to change the caller's monster - the same reference lesson as floor 10, now on a bigger box.
`describe` prints `<name>  hp <hp>  atk <attack>` with TWO spaces before hp and before atk.
